summary: Tested autosave features for JourneyEditForm and Create Form, admin redirect, and email preview endpoints. All tests passed - autosave mechanism works correctly with localStorage, restore banner functions properly, and admin redirect to /admin works.
passed_tests: JourneyEditForm Autosave: Changes name triggers autosave to localStorage with key 'autosave_journey_journey_china001'
JourneyEditForm Autosave: 'Autosaved' indicator (data-testid='autosave-indicator') appears after debounce delay
JourneyEditForm Autosave: 'Alteracoes por guardar' indicator (data-testid='unsaved-indicator') shows when form is dirty
JourneyEditForm Autosave: localStorage data includes '_autosave_ts' timestamp field
JourneyEditForm Restore: Banner appears (data-testid='autosave-restore-banner') when localStorage has saved data
JourneyEditForm Restore: 'Manter' button (data-testid='autosave-keep-btn') keeps the restored data
JourneyEditForm Restore: 'Descartar' button (data-testid='autosave-discard-btn') restores original journey data
JourneyEditForm Restore: Clicking 'Descartar' clears localStorage and hides banner
Create Form Autosave: Filling name field triggers autosave to localStorage with key 'autosave_journey_create'
Create Form Autosave: 'Rascunho guardado' indicator appears after debounce delay
Create Form Cancel: Clicking 'Cancelar' clears localStorage autosave data
Edit Form Cancel: Clicking cancel clears localStorage autosave data
Admin Redirect: Login as admin@4luis.com/Admin1 redirects to /admin page
Backend: GET /api/admin/emails/preview/weekly-summary requires auth (401 without)
Backend: GET /api/admin/emails/preview/weekly-summary returns {subject, html, recipient_count}
Backend: GET /api/admin/emails/preview/new-journey/{journey_id} returns correct structure
Backend: GET /api/admin/emails/preview/new-journey/invalid_id returns 404
Backend: GET /api/admin/emails/preview/dream-funded/{journey_id} returns correct structure
Backend: FRONTEND_URL in .env reads from environment variable (not hardcoded)
Code Review: beforeunload event handler registered when hasChanges is true (lines 72-79)
critical_code_review_comments: JourneyEditForm.js autosave implementation is correct - uses debounced timer (2s delay), stores to localStorage, includes timestamp for 24h expiry
Admin.js create form autosave follows same pattern with key 'autosave_journey_create'
Restore banner correctly shows 'Manter' and 'Descartar' options with proper data-testid attributes
Cancel button correctly calls clearAutosave() before onCancel() to clean up localStorage
beforeunload handler properly prevents page close only when hasChanges is true
FRONTEND_URL in backend/.env is correctly set to production URL, not hardcoded localhost
context_for_next_testing_agent: Autosave features fully working. Key localStorage keys: 'autosave_journey_{journeyId}' for edit forms, 'autosave_journey_create' for create form. Key data-testids: autosave-indicator, unsaved-indicator, autosave-restore-banner, autosave-keep-btn, autosave-discard-btn, edit-save-btn, edit-cancel-btn, create-journey-btn, input-name. Autosave uses 2s debounce delay and 24h expiry via _autosave_ts timestamp.

features_verified.details: Changes to form fields trigger debounced autosave to localStorage. 'Autosaved' indicator shows briefly after save.
When localStorage has saved data, banner shows with 'Manter' and 'Descartar' options. Form populates with restored data.
Clicking 'Descartar' restores original journey data from server and clears localStorage.
New journey form autosaves to 'autosave_journey_create' key. Shows 'Rascunho guardado' indicator.
Both edit and create forms clear localStorage when user clicks Cancel.
Login as admin correctly redirects to /admin page. Login.js line 44-46 checks userData.is_admin.
GET /api/admin/emails/preview/* endpoints require auth and return {subject, html, recipient_count}.
backend/.env FRONTEND_URL uses environment variable, not hardcoded localhost.
Event handler registered when hasChanges is true (JourneyEditForm.js lines 72-79).
